name: Update loyalty when adding a customer to the ticket

steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "4170"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('4', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('1', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('7', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('0', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Hazel" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the "Manicure" service
When I add the "Manicure" service to my cart
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I select the service "Manicure" in my cart
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Then I should see the total price "$51.51" visible
When I wait for the page fully loaded
When I click on the "Pay" button
When I select the "Cash" payment type
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Close Ticket"
And I should see a popup dialog with content "CHANGE$0.00OK"
When I click on the "OK" button in the popup dialog
Then I should be redirected to HOME page
Given I am on the TICKET_ADJUSTMENT page
When I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the "Ticket Adjustment" screen
And I should see the text "TICKET#" visible
When I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the first ticket with total "$51.51"
When I select the first ticket with total "$51.51"
Then I should see the service "Manicure" in my cart
When I add the phone number customer "9999999999"
Then I should see a new customer "Tin" on ticket
When I click on the "CONFIRM" button
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Confirm Save Ticket"
When I click on the "SAVE" button in the popup dialog
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the text "Please select a ticket." in the ticket adjustment screen
Given I am on the GIFT_CARD_BALANCE page
When I click on the "LOYALTY" button
Then I should see the first date is today in the loyalty detail list
And I should see the first type "Issuance" in the loyalty detail list
And I should see the first amount "51" in the gift card detail list
